name: repr-werkbank
description: Process model representation workbench: reads BPMN 2.0 XML and PNML, derives text representations and reports which facts each one carries.
author: Fabian Rybinski

scripts.build: npm run build -w @repr-werkbank/core && npm run build -w @repr-werkbank/cli && npm run build -w @repr-werkbank/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @repr-werkbank/core && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
